charm-species-demon.allpeater.name: Trilane Firing Order
charm-species-demon.allpeater.flavor: A brass card of three notches, worn smooth at the middle one. Whoever carries it decides which lane the volume goes to, and every barrel in the field reads the same card.

charm-species-demon.ashthreepeater.name: Cinder Tally
charm-species-demon.ashthreepeater.flavor: Burnt through three times and re-strung with wire each time. It counts what the fire finished rather than what it started, which is the only count anyone has ever been paid on.

charm-species-demon.bucketnutzombie.name: The Sexton's Pail
charm-species-demon.bucketnutzombie.flavor: Dented flat on one side from being used as a shovel, and flat on the other from being used as a head. The ground it opens does not close on its own, and neither does the hole it leaves in a row.
